sameProductSupportingSources.versionBoundary: Guide explicitly describes old black-only, sole-target, donor-choice version. Current official/client removes black/sole restrictions for initial activation, adds target removal and RANDOM payment. Never copy those obsolete initial conditions. Unchanged reciprocal clause observations are supporting guide evidence only.

versionBoundary: Current official hero and public-client skill3439 agree. The 2024 OL author guide describes an obsolete black-only, initially-sole, donor-choice version. Its old activation and payment restrictions are not used. Only its unchanged reciprocal support-card/distance observations and HE scope are supplementary evidence, not a current exclusive FAQ.

ruleInterpretation.rule: The initial optional clause can add or remove targets from an already multi-target Slash or ordinary trick. Select at most max(1, actual MaxHp-Hp) distinct other living players; freeze X when its real activation starts. Every initial addition independently obeys current native distance, target prohibitions, suit/color policies and card-family legality. True lost HP is separate from treated-wounded booleans.
ruleInterpretation.classification: Current primary text plus native card legality; X freeze is implementation inference.

ruleInterpretation.rule: Borrowed Sword changes an entire weapon-holder/victim pair. Its holder alone is the selected person and random donor. Native prepared Slash target plans are reordered to retain each surviving recipient's real state; newly added recipients receive fresh ordinary target state. Removing every target settles the original paid use without a replacement declaration.
ruleInterpretation.classification: Compound-card/native continuation composition inference; no dedicated current OL FAQ found.

ruleInterpretation.rule: Each selected person randomly gives one currently transferable genuine Hand or Equipment entity to LiuPan. Use the engine random stream once and preserve the exact movement invoice. GeneralWeapon cannot transfer; there is no false movement if a selected person has no transferable HE. Real Lion recovery, Ox grain spill and all resulting health, movement, death and skill-change children finish before proceeding to the next person.
ruleInterpretation.classification: Current random-give text, supplementary old same-product HE observation, and native equipment rules.

ruleInterpretation.rule: Every selected person receives the later right after its own gift/skip subtree even when there was no transferable card. This follows the unconditional wording “这些角色”; no dedicated FAQ was found. The issued right survives turns, rounds and the original skill's loss, regrant or issuer death. A dead holder cannot begin another use.
ruleInterpretation.classification: Explicit implementation inference for the unconditional grant and duration/source composition.

ruleInterpretation.rule: The next genuine basic/ordinary-trick Use with exactly one real designated player binds the holder's rights and consumes them once, including decline. The holder may draw one or add the original living LiuPan as a legal extra target. Only distance is waived for that additional target; all other native restrictions remain. Supportive self Peach, Alcohol and implicit-self DrawTwo keep their real native continuations. A dying Peach/Alcohol is considered only if the actual native Use has a real unique designation; Dodge/Nullification response opponents and pure played/provided cards are not invented targets.
ruleInterpretation.classification: Current primary text and unchanged same-product support/distance observations, with true-use/designation composition inference.

ruleInterpretation.rule: All pending rights from the same original LiuPan owner and skill bind to one next-use opportunity, preserving every original instance/source invoice and consuming all of them together; they do not multiply that one draw. Independent issuers have independent opportunities in the native target window. Binding belongs to the actual holder accepted at that window; later actor changes cannot invent a new entitlement.
ruleInterpretation.classification: Overlapping-source and actor-chain implementation inference; not a claimed official exclusive ruling.

ruleInterpretation.rule: One scalar invoice per committed target choice, complete pair, original/final slot, random selected material, paid movement, grant and consumption reconstructs the exact native history. Only its owning ProgramSkillFrame holds an active cursor/pending movement; use frames hold frozen native target tails and issued groups. No use-ID sidecar or fabricated turn/phase/card event is used.
ruleInterpretation.classification: Checkpoint, replay, privacy and native return contract.

verification.scope: Four actual-command focused behavior groups passed centrally, including initial native add/remove/zero targets, prepared Slash and current-fire composition, BorrowedSword pairs, real supportive uses, long-lived issued rights, genuine Dodge/rescue Peach, source replacement/death, private HE gifts and paid native children. Routine verification is a separate measured scope; no manual full run is claimed.
